title: Frozen 0.7.0 formats, identities and inventories
summary: Every identity row of knowledge/identities and every machine format of 0.7.0 (config keys and env names, CLI names/options/exit codes, publish tags and resources, event types and AccessEvent payloads, audit rows, exception classes and codes, doctor and explain JSON) is frozen as a snapshot test; the 0.7.0 API manifests, the serializable-FQCN inventory, the azg_ grant-field evidence and the consumers of Scopes/ folder discovery are recorded.
why: I17 and release-gate condition 8 require frozen non-PHP contracts; P2 and P3 change code around them, so the 0.7.0 values must be pinned before any change. The serializable-FQCN list protects host-stored class names (architecture#persistence). Hard risk: public formats and identities.

include: Commands: extend tests/Fixtures/Console/commands.json and CommandsSnapshotTest with exit codes per command (success, usage error, failure paths that exist at 0.7.0); every row of identities#commands present with its 0.7.0 options

Config: ConfigKeysTest keeps the key snapshot; add defaults of every identities#config key and the environment names AZGUARD_DB_CONNECTION, AZGUARD_BUILD_ID; defaults.gate.mode snapshotted as present at 0.7.0 with owner phase P2 (retired)

Resources: one snapshot test for every identities#resources row that exists at 0.7.0 — publish tags (azguard-config, azguard-migrations, azguard-filament-config), stub publish path, both core migration basenames, generated named-storage migration pattern, middleware aliases azguard.panel/azguard.can, container alias azguard, translation namespace azguard, view namespace azguard-filament, queue hidden-context key, plugin id azguard/audit, reserved azguard/* prefix, system actor type azguard:system, storage_state.schema keys; rows marked new (P2/P3) are listed as absent at 0.7.0

Events: every identities#events row — EventType case, type string, class; AccessEvent::toArray() envelope keys (event_id, type, occurred_at, panel, tenant, actor, correlation_id, state, data keys) and the exact state object keys per event class
Audit rows: the journal row written for each event type (columns and payload JSON equal to toArray())
Exceptions: every identities#exceptions row — class, parent, code (abstract classes recorded as abstract)
Doctor: every identities#doctor row — check class, key, finding ids; azguard:doctor --json document shape on a fixture world (keys, finding objects, exit code)
Explain: azguard:explain --json document shape for allow, deny and not-applicable decisions on a fixture world

API manifests: tests/Fixtures/Baseline070/api-manifest/core.json and filament.json — byte copies of packages/core/api-manifest.json and packages/filament/api-manifest.json at the baseline commit, plus a test that they are byte-identical to `git show 09612160c98ca6133c894a8f90f5653b9dac6b8f:<path>`

Serializable-FQCN inventory: tests/Fixtures/Baseline070/serializable-fqcn.json — Kernel values, enums, events, decision values and exceptions that hosts may serialize; a test that every listed FQCN exists and that its target-map row keeps target == current
azg_ evidence: a test pinning that 0.7.0 AzGuard\Schema\Field accepts names with the azg_ prefix, with the result recorded in tests/Fixtures/Baseline070/README.md for the P2 upgrade map

Scopes/ folder discovery: a snapshot of what discovery collects from a Scopes/ fixture directory and a recorded list of its consumers (AzGuardConfig DISCOVERY_KEYS/'Scopes', AzGuardServiceProvider, Authorization\Visibility, Authorization\Pipeline\Stages\AuthorityStage, Diagnostics\Checks\DiscoveryCached) in the README
exclude: DDL snapshots (exist: tests/Fixtures/Storage/ddl, extended by P1.1)
Member-level API inventory (P2); post-1.0 stable-tag comparison (P4)
Fixing a mismatch between code and knowledge/identities — report it instead

rules: No production change: `git diff --quiet 09612160c98ca6133c894a8f90f5653b9dac6b8f -- packages/` holds at hand-off.

Snapshot values come from running the 0.7.0 code, not from copying the knowledge document; then every knowledge/identities row is checked against them. A difference is recorded as a finding in the plan log (`plan.py log`) and reported; the snapshot keeps the code value.
Each snapshot test names its invariant (I17) and states that it blocks now.
Snapshots are JSON fixtures compared exactly (ordered keys, no regex placeholders except for generated ULIDs/timestamps, which are normalised by one helper).
Identities marked new (P2/P3) or retired are represented explicitly (absent at 0.7.0 / present with owner phase), so later phases change a fixture deliberately, never silently.

The serializable-FQCN list is derived from code (enums, Kernel values, events, decision values, exceptions, classes implementing JsonSerializable/__serialize) and cross-checked with target-map; a listed type whose target-map row moves it is reported to the owner, not resolved here.
guidance: Put new snapshot tests in `tests/Regression/Baseline070/` (Regression suite runs in `composer test` and on every driver) and their fixtures in `tests/Fixtures/Baseline070/Formats/`. Reuse existing worlds for doctor/explain/event output (`tests/Fixtures/Crm/CrmWorld`, `tests/Fixtures/Events/EventWorld`, `tests/Fixtures/Changes/ChangeWorld`). Exit codes: drive commands with `artisan()` and assert the returned code for the success path and each documented failure path; record them next to the existing signatures in `commands.json`. README.md in `tests/Fixtures/Baseline070/` lists: generation commit, the azg_ result, Scopes/ discovery consumers, and any finding filed against knowledge/identities.
